source_message.text: Yes, definitely — I can fully modernize your app on both platforms. That includes OS and framework upgrades, refactoring deprecated API usage, large-scale localization with correct RTL support, and reducing app size through App Bundles and iOS Thinning, while ensuring the app stays lightweight and store-compliant. I've completed this type of work for international fintech and SaaS clients, so the entire scope is achievable. I'm happy to review the repo and provide a solid estimate.
